questions.question: Which of the following alkali metal ions has the highest ionic mobility in aqueous solution?
questions.explanation: Ionic mobility is inversely proportional to the degree of hydration. Li$^+$ has the smallest ionic size and thus the highest charge density, leading to the largest hydration shell and lowest ionic mobility. Conversely, Rb$^+$ has the largest ionic size and lowest charge density, resulting in the smallest hydration shell and highest ionic mobility in aqueous solution.

questions.question: Which of the following elements is known as an alkaline earth metal?
questions.explanation: Alkaline earth metals belong to Group 2 of the periodic table. Magnesium (Mg) is a Group 2 element, while Sodium (Na) and Potassium (K) are alkali metals (Group 1), and Aluminium (Al) is a p-block element (Group 13).

questions.question: Which of the following statements is INCORRECT regarding the mole concept?

options.text: One mole of any substance contains Avogadro's number of particles.
The molar mass of a compound is the sum of the atomic masses of all atoms present in the formula.
One mole of any gas at STP occupies 22.4 L.
The mass of one mole of hydrogen gas (H₂) is 1 gram.
options.explanation: The molar mass of hydrogen gas (H₂) is 2 g/mol (since the atomic mass of H is 1 g/mol, and there are two H atoms). Therefore, the mass of one mole of hydrogen gas is 2 grams, not 1 gram. Options A, B, and C are correct statements related to the mole concept.
